needle_state.description: Current state of needle-skin interaction during tattooing — describes penetration depth and ink behavior
needle_state.rule: Describes needle behavior relative to skin, not cartridge modification

states.label: just touching epidermis
states.usage: needle barely touches skin surface

states.label: shallow dermis penetration
states.usage: needle enters first skin layer

states.label: mid dermis ink deposit
states.usage: ink visibly deposited under skin

states.label: deep pigment packing
states.usage: needle at full working depth, pigment packing
states.constraints: consistent ink flow, slight skin stress

states.label: lift off after pass
states.usage: needle lifting after completing a pass
states.constraints: ink residue on needle tip visible

states.label: hovering above skin
states.usage: needle poised above skin before contact

states.label: color change wipe
states.usage: needle wiped clean between color changes
states.constraints: ink residue on paper towel visible nearby

skin_state.description: Visible condition of the skin being tattooed — reaction and healing indicators
skin_state.rule: Describes skin response, not cartridge or machine state

states.label: fresh skin redness
states.usage: post needle contact skin reaction

states.label: ink diffusion under skin
states.usage: ink spreading under epidermis

states.label: clean skin prep
states.usage: skin cleaned and shaved, ready for stencil

states.label: stencil applied
states.usage: purple stencil lines visible on skin

states.label: wipe residue
states.usage: excess ink being wiped, skin slightly stained
states.constraints: paper towel or gauze in frame

states.label: vaseline protected
states.usage: thin vaseline layer on skin for needle glide
states.constraints: slight shine visible on skin surface

states.label: bandaged fresh
states.usage: fresh tattoo wrapped in protective film

states.label: healing day 1-3
states.usage: tattoo in early healing, slight redness persists

states.label: peeling stage
states.usage: skin peeling, tattoo settling

states.label: fully healed
states.usage: tattoo fully settled, vibrant colors

machine_state.description: Operational state of the tattoo machine relative to the work
machine_state.rule: Describes machine behavior, not machine design

states.label: idle parked
states.usage: machine resting on surface, not in use

states.label: running in air
states.usage: machine running with no skin contact

states.label: mid-stroke
states.usage: machine actively tattooing, needle in skin

states.label: dipping ink
states.usage: needle tip dipping into ink cap for reload
states.constraints: ink cap in foreground, machine tilted
